items.title: Decide on / return signed consent to the rent increase
items.quote: Für Ihre Entscheidung haben Sie bis zum Ablauf des zweiten Kalendermonats nach dem Zugang dieses Schreibens Zeit.
items.computation: The letter states it was delivered by messenger, placed directly in the mailbox on 19.11.2026 in the morning ('Durch Boten zugestellt: Einwurf in Ihren Briefkasten am 19.11.2026 vormittags'), so Zugang (receipt) = 19.11.2026, no need for the 3-day postal fiction. Under § 558b Abs. 1 BGB, the tenant's declaration period runs until the end of the second calendar month following the month of receipt: the month of receipt (November 2026) does not count; the first following calendar month is December 2026, the second is January 2027. The period therefore ends with the expiry of 31.01.2027. 31.01.2027 falls on a Sunday; under § 193 BGB a declaration due on a Sunday, Saturday or public holiday is instead due on the next working day, which is Monday 01.02.2027 (not a Berlin public holiday). Final deadline: 01.02.2027.

items.title: Proposed new net cold rent takes effect (if consent given)
items.quote: Wir bitten Sie daher, einer Erhöhung der Nettokaltmiete auf 718,00 € (10,56 € je m²) mit Wirkung ab dem 01.02.2027 zuzustimmen.
items.computation: The letter explicitly names the date on which the increased rent of 718,00 € is to take effect, contingent on the tenant's consent: 01.02.2027. This is a stated calendar date, taken as given.
